request: 10 further focused passes to improve usefulness and precision.
passDefinition: One distinct labeled source/path execution context per pass. These ten contexts are focused regressions, not ten independent repository audits or an exhaustive coverage claim. Supplemental controls and native witnesses are outside this ledger.

admission.existingOwner: SARJ510 owns the requested explicit data-union discriminator policy; no new rule or severity change is needed.
admission.demonstratedGap: Native-valid metadata in a plain local class namespace or an immutable tuple warned. Unrelated parameter attribute writes hid module bindings, and constructor-only InitVar annotations suppressed missing-tag warnings.
admission.harm: False warnings encourage unnecessary constructor or serialization changes; missed warnings undermine the requested modeling policy.
admission.boundary: Nominal unions remain valid Python. This warning expresses a modeling preference and has no universally safe autofix.
admission.smallestFix: Extend only the existing bounded SARJ510 AST helper. Leave shared provenance and other rules unchanged.

refinements: Respect bounded metadata projections from single-value plain local class namespaces and immutable tuples.
Invalidate projection proof on carrier mutation, rebinding, escape or unsupported class behavior; retain finite budgets.
Keep module bindings independent of unrelated parameter attribute writes while preserving real global writes and escapes.
Treat direct import-proven no-default dataclass InitVar annotations as constructor inputs rather than persistent discriminators.
Preserve real ClassVar Literal tags alongside InitVar and Pydantic callable metadata on single-record or duplicate-collapsed aliases.

nativeEvidence.qualification: Native runtime and BasedPyright witnesses cover all ten ledger contexts. Two proposed cardinality gaps were rejected because Pydantic routes these valid schemas; they remain negative controls.

upstreamReview.result: InitVar annotations identify constructor inputs; they do not provide persistent instance discriminator fields.
Installed Pydantic 2.14.1 native witnesses validate class/tuple metadata and singleton or duplicate-collapsed callable discriminator schemas. A proposed cardinality restriction was rejected.
Existing upstream review remains applicable: SARJ510 owns this shared data-union modeling preference.

limitations: All prior inherited, generic, behavior-bearing, runtime TypeAliasType union, dynamic namespace and configuration-heavy record exclusions remain in place.

Metadata projection support is bounded and local. Class namespaces have one plain value binding and no bases, decorators or methods. Cross-file metadata is not resolved. Opaque mutation, carrier escapes and unsupported projections can abstain.

InitVar handling is limited to direct import-proven annotations without defaults on admitted dataclasses. Wrapped, locally aliased and defaulted forms remain conservative; no constructor or serializer rewrite is offered.
No interprocedural effect inference is claimed. Binding-sensitive mutation proof remains local to SARJ510; ambiguous or excessive forms can remain intentional false negatives.
The ten cases and inspected corpora establish bounded evidence, not population-wide precision or complete recall.

validation.basedPyrightQualification: Targeted strict project check with the worktree virtual-environment Python path; 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 notes.

localMakeVerify.reason: The latest full local run passed doctor, source/catalog/CLI/docs synchronization, formatted examples, documentation checks, lint, and the ordinary standards check (0 errors, 34 existing warnings). performanceNotes.runtime: CPython 3.15.0 on a shared Linux VM.
performanceNotes.isolation: Fresh interpreter per corpus and bounded batch; 250-file batch limit, verified private pins before and after.
performanceNotes.coldWarmDefinition: First and second analysis passes within each interpreter; this does not mean clearing OS caches.
performanceNotes.combinedSelection: Ten tracked Python files per corpus, taking every ceil(file_count / 10) entry from the sorted pinned inventory.
performanceNotes.baselineQualification: The calibration helper originates at f39ae8ae and is byte-identical at the labeled ledger baseline 5d6b1581 and integrated main commit 98b73b68. The packages/python trees at 5d6b1581 and 98b73b68 are identical. Both modes use the same current Python engine and canonical per-file registry.
performanceNotes.combinedCpuObservation: Candidate combined CPU medians were 3.5% higher cold and 6.4% higher warm; rule-only medians were lower. These three repetitions on a shared VM do not establish a speed improvement.
performanceNotes.interpretation: Three paired repetitions support regression review; no speed improvement or population precision claim is made.

calibration.baseline_strategy: Same current Python engine/registry; substitute the SARJ510 data-union helper from f39ae8ae.

combined.scope: All 145 canonical per-file Python rules through check_source; excludes project rules and discovery.

limitations: Shared VM load affects wall time; these measurements do not establish a speed improvement.
